links.to_node: I initiate the server system upgrade
The company's server system goes offline for a few hours
The company's operations temporarily halt during the offline period
The data processing speed of the company's server system improves slightly after the upgrade
The scheduled maintenance by the server provider is effectively replaced by my upgrade downtime.
